description: PhotoCraft: An open-source photo editor written from scratch in pure Rust
summary: What catches my eye here isn't the Photoshop clone itself but the control architecture: every editing action is a command object, so the same engine that drives the GUI can be driven from a CLI, a JSON control channel, or an MCP server. That's the exact pattern I'm pushing toward with PenguPool and AgentOn Pocket, treating a heavyweight application as a composable service an agent can call into instead of something you have to sit at and click through. And the fact that it's pure Rust on wgpu, no Electron, no web view, offline by default, makes it the kind of local-first tool I can drop into a pipeline and actually trust rather than another cloud dependency I have to babysit.
